summary.text: Ken Chestek is a Democratic state representative from Wyoming who has represented House District 13 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A professor by career, he holds a law degree from the University of Pittsburgh.

paragraphs.text: Ken Chestek was born in Cincinnati, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree from Penn State University in 1975 and a law degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 1979.
His career experience includes working as a professor.
Chestek took office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 2, 2023, succeeding Cathy Connolly.
In the 2025-2026 session his committee assignments include the House Judiciary Committee, the House Rules and Procedure Committee, the Joint Judiciary Committee and the Select Water Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 18, 2026.
